note: macOS-generated golden vectors for the OnlyCue schema ladder. One representative document per schema version 1...23, each paired with the v23 model the Swift ladder produces. The C# OnlyCue.Core re-implementation must reproduce every case. UUIDs that the migration mints (v1, v2, and the v8-v10 tempo fan-out) appear as MINTED-000N placeholders, numbered by first appearance, because their real values differ on every run; ids carried over from the input stay literal. includedTypeIDs is sorted because it is a Swift Set and its JSON order is randomised per process. To regenerate after a deliberate ladder change, delete golden/cuelist-migration-v1.json and re-run the test suite.
